events.title: Steam Fest Live AMA: Ask Us Anything, Thursday Oct 22 at 7 PM ET
events.summary: Got questions? We've got answers. Join us Thursday, October 22, from 7:00 to 8:00 PM ET for a live Ask Me Anything with the Kvayo Software family, the dad and kids building American Gold Rush. What to ask Anything you like. How a family makes a game together. Dahlonega, Georgia, in 1829, and the first American gold rush, twenty years before California. The art and sound, all made by real artists, not AI. What you thought of the demo. And what's coming in Early Access. Drop your questions in chat

events.title: American Gold Rush is heading to Steam Next Fest
events.summary: We got in. American Gold Rush has been accepted into Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26, and our free demo will be playable for the whole week. What you will be playing Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. Twenty years before California, the first American gold rush started here, and the gold was not sitting on the surface waiting to be found.
